rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (S.2983)
rules.requirement: A Massachusetts bill would ban algorithmic rent setting, but it is not law. As of the latest action it was referred to the Senate Committee on Ways and Means, so it gives renters no rights yet.

coverage.summary: Bill text not shown on this page; as a conduct prohibition it would apply statewide if enacted.

rules.citation: Mass. Senate Bill S.2983 (194th General Court) (new draft of S.994 and S.1016)
